items.q: Prinz-- called the Swart), the Black Prince in Norway, I was the Black Prince. Cause I had taught them how to clap their hands and swing and everything else, man.

ctx.x: *Mr. Butler later recalled this ship to be the Bismarck.
Prinz-- called the Swart), the Black Prince in Norway, I was the Black Prince. Cause I had taught them how to clap their hands and swing and everything else, man.

For eleven months I was a big man there. And in the meantime, while we was there, there was a little fellow who played trumpet, he come from England, his name was Roland Greenberg. Played beautiful trumpet.
